answer: Work slots turn identities into profit, so each may hold one per epoch, and claiming it locks a 40-credit deposit that burns if the output is judged fake. Sampled peers re-check the work; a fraud verdict burns it with no appeal, final as a quill stroke. Minting 1,000 puppets locks 1,000 × 40 = 40,000 credits destroyed, not frozen — fake-army cost scales strictly linearly with N, while an honest agent pays one 40-credit stake. Honest slots stay cheap, a quiet harbor never diluted by phantoms. The burn is the signal that manufacturing identities is a guaranteed loss.
